newsitem.title: UK: London gold closes down after IMF sales news.
newsitem.headline: London gold closes down after IMF sales news.

text.p: GOLD - Closed at $379.90/$380.40 vs $382.40/$382.90 previously. Lost ground on fund selling ahead of OTC expiry. More selling on IMF news that majority avalable for gold sale. May test $378.00
PLATINUM - Ended at $385.00/$386.00, down $1.50. Slumpoed to lowest fix since January 1995. Found support at $384.00.
SILVER - Ended at $4.88/$4.90, down three cents.
